description: Two strict machines. A loud `Knock` that Visitor r2 sends to Door r1 is a message, taken by `Shut`'s `ignore`. Door's emitted `Opened` reaches r2 in `Idle`, which has no `on door.Opened`: an emitted event is not one of r2's own, so it is dropped, not a defect. A quiet `Knock` is ignored in `Ajar`; back in `Shut`, one ends r1 with an `unhandled` defect whose input is the message, with its sender and message id. r2's next send finds r1 ended and is `undelivered`, which does not fail a strict sender.
